principle: Zero Test-to-Train Information Leakage across Static and Dynamic Scales

Category_A_Fixed_Physical_Normalization.description: Fixed reference constants derived from SOURCE_A design specifications used to make raw engineering quantities dimensionless without data-driven fitting.

Category_B_Learned_Training_Normalizatio.description: Empirical channel-wise mean and standard deviation computed strictly over training simulations. Validation and OOD test sets are standardized using these exact frozen training statistics.
Category_B_Learned_Training_Normalizatio.training_split_basis: SOURCE_A (70 GMs) + B_train_1..4 (70 GMs) = 140 training simulations
Category_B_Learned_Training_Normalizatio.prohibition: No test set observation (ID, Interp, Extrap, Topology) may contribute to mean/std computation.

Category_C_Test_Specific_Normalization.description: Standardizing each OOD test structure by its own empirical response mean and variance is prohibited, as it constitutes test-time leakage.
Category_C_Test_Specific_Normalization.exception: Ground motion scaling: If normalized by incident ground motion RMS, this is physically observable at deployment time and permitted.
